# superset_group (Resource)

Manages a group of users, on Superset 6: its members get the roles of the group. The group endpoints belong to the Flask-AppBuilder security API, which Superset only enables with `FAB_ADD_SECURITY_API = True`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_role" "analysts" {
  name = "Analysts"
}

resource "superset_group" "finance" {
  name        = "finance"
  label       = "Finance"
  description = "The finance team"
  roles       = [superset_role.analysts.id]
  users       = [superset_user.alice.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the group, unique in Superset.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description of the group.
- `label` (String) Label shown instead of the name.
- `roles` (Set of Number) Identifiers of the roles the members of the group get, for example from `superset_role`.
- `users` (Set of Number) Identifiers of the members of the group, for example from `superset_user`. When unset, the members are left as they are, as made by the `groups` of the users; when set, the group has exactly these members, and `[]` removes them all. Manage a membership from one side only, here or in `superset_user`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the group.
